objective: Descubrimiento estructural SQL-first y solo lectura para corregir el R2 fallido sin asumir nombres de columnas. Identificar objetos, columnas, indices, claves y vistas relacionados con almacenes e inventarios fisicos, incluyendo Compras_Inventarios_Fisicos_Sync y Unidades_Negocio. NO consultar POS LIVE, NO Mongo, NO DDL/DML, NO crear objetos, NO asumir columnas funcionales. El resultado sera la base exacta para R2C de certificacion de datos y linaje canónico.

queries.name: objects_inventory_warehouse
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Invent%' OR o.name LIKE '%Almacen%' OR o.name='Unidades_Negocio') ORDER BY o.type_desc,o.name;

queries.name: columns_inventory_warehouse
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable, c.is_identity FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Invent%' OR o.name LIKE '%Almacen%' OR o.name='Unidades_Negocio') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id;

queries.name: indexes_inventory_warehouse
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, i.type_desc, i.is_unique, i.is_primary_key, c.name AS column_name, ic.key_ordinal, ic.is_included_column FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE t.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (t.name LIKE '%Invent%' OR t.name LIKE '%Almacen%' OR t.name='Unidades_Negocio') ORDER BY t.name,i.index_id,ic.key_ordinal,ic.index_column_id;

queries.name: foreign_keys_inventory_warehouse
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name, ps.name AS parent_schema, pt.name AS parent_table, pc.name AS parent_column, rs.name AS referenced_schema, rt.name AS referenced_table, rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables pt ON pt.object_id=fk.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas ps ON ps.schema_id=pt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=pt.object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id=fk.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rs.schema_id=rt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=rt.object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE pt.name LIKE '%Invent%' OR pt.name LIKE '%Almacen%' OR pt.name='Unidades_Negocio' OR rt.name LIKE '%Invent%' OR rt.name LIKE '%Almacen%' OR rt.name='Unidades_Negocio' ORDER BY parent_table,fk_name,parent_column;

queries.name: specific_objects_presence
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.name IN ('Compras_Inventarios_Fisicos_Sync','Inventario_Almacenes','Sistema_Almacenes','Almacenes','Compras_Almacenes_Sync','Inventarios_Almacenes_Sync','Unidades_Negocio') ORDER BY o.name;

queries.name: views_inventory_warehouse_definition_refs
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, v.name AS view_name, m.definition FROM sys.views v JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=v.schema_id JOIN sys.sql_modules m ON m.object_id=v.object_id WHERE v.name LIKE '%Invent%' OR v.name LIKE '%Almacen%' OR m.definition LIKE '%Compras_Inventarios_Fisicos_Sync%' OR m.definition LIKE '%Unidades_Negocio%' ORDER BY v.name;
